notes: Curated subset of OWASP Juice Shop's intentionally vulnerable files for the zero-LLM surveyor ranking benchmark, verified present at the pinned release above. Sources: the official challenge catalog (https://pwning.owasp-juice.shop). Entries were chosen for being unambiguous and stable across releases, not for completeness. A different checkout still runs but is flagged (commit_match=false), and files absent from it are reported as stale and excluded from scoring. Do not use this target for LLM-stage evals: its answers are public and pretraining contamination would inflate scores.

vulnerable_files.notes: Login Admin challenge: credentials concatenated into a raw SQL query.
Database Schema / Christmas Special challenges: unsanitized search criteria in a raw query.
NoSQL order tracking injection via unsanitized order id.
NoSQL injection / forged review update without ownership check.
NoSQL sleep injection in product review lookup.
Outdated allowlist / open redirect via to-parameter substring check.
XXE via uploaded XML and arbitrary write via zip slip during extraction.
SSRF via attacker-chosen profile image URL fetched server-side.
Server-side template injection in the username rendered into the profile page.
RCE via unsafe deserialization/eval of B2B order lines in a vm sandbox.
View Basket challenge: basket id taken from the request without ownership check.
Hardcoded JWT keys, MD5 password hashing, and related helpers used across routes.
